rows.text: • Raising full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share outlook to $21.71 to $21.87 compared with the prior outlook of $20.73 to $20.99, and raising full year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per share outlook to $25.40 to $25.50, compared with the prior outlook of $24.45 to $24.65

Based on its current outlook, the company’s management believes that fourth quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.68 to $5.83, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $21.71 to $21.87.

The company’s management further believes that fourth quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $6.60 to $6.70, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $25.40 to $25.50.

• Raising full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share outlook to $20.73 to $20.99 compared with the prior outlook of $20.08 to $20.44, and raising full year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per share outlook to $24.45 to $24.65, compared with the prior outlook of $23.85 to $24.15

Based on its current outlook, the company’s management believes that third quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.10 to $5.25, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $20.73 to $20.99.

The company’s management further believes that third quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $6.05 to $6.15, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $24.45 to $24.65.
